decisions.reason: The position requires fabrication, supply, and installation of a complete aeration system, including its compressor unit and support frame.

items.material_name: Single-tier high-performance crossflow aeration system, 2300 × 1350 × 650 mm, 11 L/s, with sound-insulated 400 V compressor unit (2.2 kW reference rating, 400 Nm³/h at 50 mbar) and 1.4301 stainless steel support frame rated for 22 kN
items.description: Complete CO₂ stripping system with DN 150 water connections, inlet and outlet modules, reaction module, compressor, and support frame.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of a new air filtration unit. Both filter elements are included components.

items.material_name: Two-stage 1.4571 stainless steel air filter unit, F7/H13, DN 200 line connections, minimum 900 m³/h, 800 Pa filter burst pressure
items.description: Includes replaceable F7 and H13 filters, LCD differential pressure monitor, condensate drains, and wall brackets.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of new exterior exhaust louvers with included screens and duct adapters.

items.material_name: 1.4571 stainless steel fixed-blade exterior exhaust louver, DN 200 duct adapter, minimum 900 m³/h, for approximately 200 mm wall thickness
items.description: Rain-resistant, tamper-resistant louver with overlapping Z-shaped blades at least 2 mm thick and a removable 1 × 1 mm screen.
